name: the highest identifier that answers becomes coordinator
mechanism: a node that suspects the coordinator failed sends an election to all higher identifiers; any that answer take over the election; a node that hears no higher answer within a timeout declares itself coordinator to all

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Bully algorithm' in section Distributed systems algorithms:

fails_when: message storms; a slow high node is presumed dead
